note.note:
I’m ready to create the SOAP clinical note, but I don’t have the transcript or DDx yet. Please paste both of the following:

1) The full clinical transcript (conversation between clinician and patient).  
2) The Differential Diagnosis (DDx) JSON from the diagnostic agent.

Notes:
- I will treat the transcript as the primary source and use the DDx only to enrich clinical reasoning when consistent.  
- If there are contradictions I will mark “conflict noted.”  
- I will not infer or fabricate clinical facts (no vitals, labs, meds doses, etc., unless provided).  
- If medications are listed without dose/route/frequency I will note “dose/route/frequency not documented.”

Paste the transcript and DDx and I will generate the SOAP note in the exact structure you requested.
